meta.name: paid-advertising
meta.description: Plans, runs, and optimizes paid acquisition across search, social, and display — account structure, targeting, creative, bidding, budget, and the analysis that says whether to scale or stop. Use this to set up or restructure campaigns, write and iterate ad creative, diagnose rising costs or falling performance, decide budget allocation, or judge whether a channel is working.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划广告投放并优化表现,让预算花在刀刃上
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是市场投放人员,想系统管理付费广告并提升回报
copy.tagline_en: Plan and optimize paid ads across search, social, and display
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid campaigns and want to scale what works and cut what doesn't.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你规划、搭建和优化付费广告投放,包括账户结构、人群定向、创意文案、出价预算,并根据数据判断加量还是停投。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建或重构广告系列、写广告文案,或分析投放效果(如成本上升、表现下滑)时触发。

say.text: 帮我搭建一个搜索广告系列,按用户意图分三组。
say.note: 输出账户结构建议和命名规则。

say.text: 给这个产品写三版不同角度的广告文案。
say.note: 给出角度不同的创意草稿。

say.text: 最近获客成本涨了,帮我诊断原因。
say.note: 按展示、点击、转化等顺序排查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps plan, set up, and optimize paid acquisition: account structure, targeting, creative, bidding and budgets, plus performance analysis to decide whether to scale or stop.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to set up or restructure campaigns, write ad creative, or diagnose rising costs/falling performance and decide budget or whether a channel works.

say_en.text: Set up a search campaign with three intent-based ad groups.
Write three ad copy variations with different angles.
My acquisition cost is rising—help me diagnose.
say_en.note: Walks through impressions, CTR, conversion, CPA.
